classification.difficultyReason: Identify negative gradients by the direction of each line, without calculation.

content.prompt: Consider these lines. Circle the graphs with a negative gradient.

spec.description: Eight editable coordinate sketches in two rows of four. Positive axis ends have arrowheads; axes have no labels, ticks or numerical scales. Source cyan is mapped to house blue; orange, red and green graph series use the standard palette.
spec.mathematics: A and D rise through the axes; B and C fall through the axes. E falls steeply through both positive half-axes. F rises shallowly below the horizontal axis. G falls above the horizontal axis. H rises steeply to the left of the vertical axis. Sketch coordinates establish these qualitative relationships only and are not numerical givens.
spec.answerVisibility: No answers or circles appear in the question diagram.

answer.worked: B, C, E and G slope downwards from left to right, so their gradients are negative.
